conditionalEffects.description: Retaliate sometimes grants Oath of the Sands, improving your next Guardian's Ward or Whirling Retaliation.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you are hit by an attack, your Block/parry Ratings will increase by X.
DNT - Your attacks will deal additional damage based on the number of bleeds on your target.
DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.
Up to once per second, when you Block or Partially Block:

1879064294.name: Shield-taunt
1879064294.desc: Laugh at your enemies after bashing them with your Shield-swipe, taunting them. This skill draws the enemy's attention to yourself.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Shield-swipe.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: \nYour shield skills have a 25% chance to apply a fortification effect that increases your mitigations by 1%. This effect may stack up to five times.

1879073382.name: Rain of Arrows: Light From The Sky
1879073382.desc: Rains arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to hit multiple targets.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879090790.name: Draw Attention
1879090790.desc: This skill draws the attention of nearby monsters to the Hunter's Lure trap.

1879198310.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Weathered-bear)
1879198310.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879228134.name: Spear and Spear
1879228134.desc: Capable Wardens doubly prepare their spear for attack.

1879232486.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Lynx)
1879232486.desc: Your bond with the natural world allows you to call upon old friends long gone.

1879244006.name: Splint
1879244006.desc: Splints are used in setting broken bones, particularly in the legs.

1879244262.name: Strategic Strike
1879244262.desc: Enhanced damage when striking the target from behind. The Burglar targets a vital location and deals a significant amount of damage to their target.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879260646.name: Call of the Cavalry
1879260646.desc: You cry out with a renewed vigour from atop your steed, disheartening any foolish enough to stand in your way.

1879273062.name: Juggernaut
1879273062.desc: Blocks all attacks briefly, reflecting some damage back to your enemies.

1879274086.name: Warning Shot - Light
1879274086.desc: A powerful toss which aggravates your target, forcing them to attack you.

1879275750.name: Stunning Bellow
1879275750.desc: Your target is stunned at the strength of your battle cry.

1879302630.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Swordswoman)
1879302630.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879325286.name: Muster in Arnach
1879325286.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Arnach in eastern Gondor.

1879365734.name: Osgiliath Steed
1879365734.desc: A steed descended from the old stables of ruined Osgiliath.

1879384934.name: Man-form
1879384934.desc: Beornings can resume the form of a Man in the midst of combat.

1879417830.name: Honey Goat
1879417830.desc: This goat knows the honey business.

1879422310.name: Golden Cave-claw
1879422310.desc: Summons a decorative golden cave-claw to keep you, and your treasure, company.

1879449574.name: Lesser Anthem II - Dissonance
1879449574.desc:
Anthem: Greatly increases your Cry and Call Damage.

Increases Light, Fire, Frost, and Lightning Damage of all nearby fellowship or raid members.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 1 ballad buff present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879494118.name: Guise of Goldberry
1879494118.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Goldberry. Old Man Willow wouldn't dare bother you now!

1879495142.name: Lovely Flowers
1879495142.desc: Place down a pot of lovely flowers, sure to make anyone smile.

1879497702.name: Sign of the Wild: Rage
1879497702.desc: Command your pet to attack their target with a wild and damaging attack.\n\nUsing Fire, Frost, and Lightning skills will reduce the active cooldown of this ability.

1879521254.name: Dusty Worm
1879521254.desc: Summons a fierce dusty worm to accompany you on your travels.

1879523686.name: Thunderclap
1879523686.desc: An attack with all the force and fury of booming thunder.
